response: Type /fpsfix in Discord to see recommendations on how to fix lag.

If you get a notification along the lines of "Unable to start Minecraft", this is an issue with the vanilla Minecraft launcher. We recommend switching to OneClient if you want a smooth, one-click experience, or Modrinth or Prism Launcher instead. Modrinth / Prism: https://alternatives.microcontrollers.dev/launcher/home/
OneClient, an app with the same functionality as SkyClient, is [now out](https://polyfrost.org/projects/oneclient).
